mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_settlement (settlement_no, order_id, order_no, service_mode, paid_amount, platform_subsidy, store_bay_fee, pass_through_cost, advance_amount, labor_income, commission_rate, platform_fee, worker_net, store_net, total, status, env_flag, settled_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{settlementNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{serviceMode}, #{paidAmount}, #{platformSubsidy}, #{storeBayFee}, #{passThroughCost}, #{advanceAmount}, #{laborIncome}, #{commissionRate}, #{platformFee}, #{workerNet}, #{storeNet}, #{total}, #{status}, #{envFlag}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.settlement_no AS settlement_no, s.order_id AS order_id, s.order_no AS order_no, s.service_mode AS service_mode, s.paid_amount AS paid_amount, s.platform_subsidy AS platform_subsidy, s.store_bay_fee AS store_bay_fee, s.pass_through_cost AS pass_through_cost, s.advance_amount AS advance_amount, s.labor_income AS labor_income, s.commission_rate AS commission_rate, s.platform_fee AS platform_fee, s.worker_net AS worker_net, s.store_net AS store_net, s.total AS total, s.status AS status, s.env_flag AS env_flag, s.settled_at AS settled_at FROM t_settlement s JOIN t_order o ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
